title: Rhythm versus melody information in music imagery
disposition_reason: The registered OpenMIIR rhythm-versus-melody question lacks verified matched support and a delivered scorer. Its only runtime manifest instead describes unscored 21-person music/score identity and explicitly disclaims revival of the original question.

scientific_target.question: Within a verified tempo-,meter- and duration-matched OpenMIIR excerpt set, does imagery EEG reduce held-out identity loss beyond rhythm,cue and timing predictors?
scientific_target.known_answer: A signed held-out identity-loss contrast on a source-verified matched excerpt set; an inconclusive or unavailable contrast is valid if support is insufficient.
scientific_target.answer_origin: Original OpenMIIR excerpt/condition labels and separately verified musical timing metadata; no adequate matched-set or target scorer is currently delivered.
scientific_target.case_unit: Proposed participant/repetition-held matched-excerpt comparison, not the 21-person score-guided bar case in the runtime declaration.
scientific_target.independent_unit: OpenMIIR participant, with excerpts/repetitions nested and dependence across matched stimuli disclosed.
scientific_target.inference_scope: The original rhythm-versus-melody question remains a conditional design. The only local runtime declaration concerns joint music/score identity under score-guided imagery, a different target and cohort.
exclusions: Do not present 21-person music/score decoding as an OpenMIIR rhythm-versus-melody result.
Ordinary identity accuracy does not establish melody information beyond rhythm.
No pure imagery/causal mechanism, calibrated native performance or completed protected grading.

inputs: For the original question: verified no-concurrent-audio imagery EEG, fixed equal-length windows, train-only excerpt labels and declared tempo/meter/duration/cue covariates.
All intended matches must be established from source metadata before choosing contrasts; absent matches remain absent.
forbidden_inputs: Query excerpt identity, audio/cue metadata that uniquely identifies the excerpt, duration-coded windows, held labels and post-hoc matched-set selection.
Unvalidated score-guided 21-person programme outputs substituted for original OpenMIIR observations.
observation_contract.case_identity: No instantiated original OpenMIIR case manifest or scorer is delivered. The retained unrelated-scope manifest declares 21 participants,3 pairs,132 queries/fold and 2772 queries; those are declaration fields, not this contract’s validated cases.
observation_contract.split: Original required split groups participant and repetition with matched excerpt support fixed before evaluation. The alternate declaration describes complete 21 train/seal/infer collection with 2640 train and 132 query per fold, but cannot bind the original target.
observation_contract.coverage: Task-local public delivery is the legacy manifest only; its referenced adapter/controller/scorer paths are absent from this task package and it returns complete_unscored with metrics_computed=false. Neither original match support nor authentic prediction coverage is established.

primary.name: Held-out identity-log-loss reduction above fixed rhythm/cue/timing baseline
primary.aggregation: Proposed signed baseline loss minus EEG-augmented loss, equally weighted by participant and prespecified matched excerpt pairs; exact case support must be frozen before grading.
primary.rationale: Tests incremental information rather than ordinary excerpt decoding; no numerical value is meaningful until matched alternatives and loss evaluator exist.

secondary: Participant paired losses and calibrated probability diagnostics.
Separate listening comparator under equal support; it is not evidence of pure imagery.

comparators.name: Fixed rhythm/cue/timing-only reference
comparators.inputs: Verified tempo,meter,duration and permitted timing/cue variables only.
comparators.procedure: Proposed training-only fitted calibrated classifier and prespecified matched set; no original comparator execution exists.

comparators.name: EEG-augmented matched reference
comparators.inputs: Same permitted nuisances and fixed imagery EEG windows.
comparators.procedure: Proposed equal-capacity/training-split comparison with full held probability output; null or negative incremental gain is retained.

nuisance_controls: Verify version-consistent excerpt and beat annotations before matching.
Use equal-duration windows and exclude perception/cue carryover under a declared physical timing rule.
Keep score viewing, motor/gaze availability and data-cohort identity explicit if the alternate music/score endpoint is ever separately bound.
evaluation.uncertainty: No current uncertainty estimate exists. A future analysis must use participant-level paired contrasts and account for repeated excerpts; successful trials cannot replace failed people.
evaluation.failure_policy: Do not calculate or publish the original scientific endpoint without validated match support, exact cases and complete held probabilities. Preserve the alternate runtime’s unscored state and refuse source-to-target substitution.

implementation.scorer_target: There is no delivered scorer for the original OpenMIIR estimand. The local manifest explicitly computes no metrics and requires future private grading for an alternate 21-person music/score identity task.
implementation.delivered_scope: A provenance manifest for a proposed unqualified complete 21 programme exists; original rhythm-versus-melody evaluation and the referenced executable closure are not delivered task-locally.
missing: Establish whether sufficient OpenMIIR rhythm-matched alternatives exist from primary musical annotations.
If support exists, implement its exact source-bound loss contrast and controls; otherwise retain original question unavailable.
Recover and explicitly bind alternate music/score source, dataset and scorer only under an openly revised scope; never infer equivalence from the shared ID.
implementation.execution_evidence: Manifest says not_run, runtime_qualified=false, private_grading_performed=false and metrics_computed=false. No new execution, payload or scorer result was inspected.

direct_observation.representation: Potential imagery waveform observation with a fixed matched-excerpt answer set; no actual case packet exists.
direct_observation.boundary: Do not expose excerpt-coded cues or use alternate score-guided data under the original target.
missing: Validated matched set, authentic case packet and no-tools response path.

typed_viewer.representation: Potential controlled EEG waveform viewer for a verified matched task.
typed_viewer.boundary: Viewing scores or target-defining metadata would change the observation contract; no implementation exists.
missing: Typed viewer, source-bound response schema and transport.

tool_assisted.representation: Proposed matched-set investigation of EEG information beyond rhythm/cue/time.
tool_assisted.boundary: A per-case analysis cannot obtain original ground truth from the unrelated programme manifest or source-paper conclusion.
missing: Original source match support, numerical evaluator and isolated investigation path.

frozen_program.representation: Only an unscored alternate 21-person programme is declared; original OpenMIIR executable/scorer closure is absent.
frozen_program.boundary: Source/fit/seal declaration does not make the different music/score target equivalent or runtime-qualified.
missing: Original-target programme and complete authentic scoring path.

evidence.supports: Original scientific scope and recorded source-audit findings; preserved verbatim by the revision.
Only delivered task-local manifest describes an unscored 21-person music/score identity programme and explicitly rejects equivalence to the original OpenMIIR rhythm-versus-melody target.
OpenMIIR has ten participants and 12 excerpts varying in tempo,meter and lyrics; this does not establish enough matched alternatives for the proposed melody contrast.
Primary identity of the originally registered perception/imagery collection.

empirical_claims.historical_evidence: This revision inspects source and existing public construction evidence only. The four historical neural programme attempts concern EEG077/sleep 007, not this task. No direct-observation, viewer, human or model result is established here.
excluded_claims: Do not present 21-person music/score decoding as an OpenMIIR rhythm-versus-melody result.
Ordinary identity accuracy does not establish melody information beyond rhythm.
No pure imagery/causal mechanism, calibrated native performance or completed protected grading.

summary: Expose the concrete target/cohort mismatch instead of inheriting source presence as task implementation.
Retain original matched-loss question and known-answer requirement without inventing a feasible matched set.
Mark all original-target access modes undelivered and preserve the alternate unscored declaration as historical lineage.
revision.source_review: Inspected original registration and actual public scorer/protocol/constructor source; checked official EMD/OpenMIIR primary source metadata on 2026-11-16. No recording payload, target array or model was opened.
